# Testwiz Anatomy

> Testwiz Anatomy is an interactive 3D human anatomy atlas for medical, nursing, midwifery, and allied-health students.

## What it offers

- Search named anatomical structures and common aliases.
- Explore body systems, regions, clinical pathways, Entity Q&A, and Identify Mode.
- Switch between male and female reference editions.
- Rotate, zoom, isolate, explode, focus, and share a structure link.
- Use optimized rendering on constrained phones without changing source geometry.

## Important scope

- Access to the interactive atlas requires an active Testwiz Pro subscription and is tied to the learner's Testwiz account.
- The male edition is based on BodyParts3D 4.0.
- The female edition is based on Human Reference Atlas female v1.10, with eight pelvic structures retained from v1.5. It is a whole-body orientation surface with selected organs and incomplete skeletal and muscular coverage.
- This is an educational reference, not a diagnostic or surgical tool.

Medical students, nursing students, midwifery students, anatomy and physiology learners, clinical educators, and lecturers.
